$comment: Story 4.6 (ADR-158): the last night — from the glass house down into the Purple Line at Cubbon Park.

panels.title: THE GLASS HOUSE · 23:30
panels.text: Everyone you kept, in a line, in the dark.

panels.title: CUBBON PARK STATION · 00:40
panels.text: The army's lamps on the platform. A soldier lifts the barrier and doesn't look at your faces.

panels.title: THE PURPLE LINE · 00:55
panels.text: You climb down onto the tracks. The line you watched them build. West.
